title: What Does Matching a Human Intervention Effect Establish? Benchmark Checks for LLM Simulations
abstract: arXiv:2611.27186v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM simulations are validated by equivalence with human effects, yet a zero reference passes whenever the human 90 percent interval lies inside the margin, as the human benchmark shows before simulation. When the zero reference fails, planned precision gives independent simulations the margin up to which passing is a 5 percent test of response. In an exploratory 70-experiment reanalysis, 72 percent of GPT-4's $\pm$0.20 SD passes were zero-reference passes; GPT-4 passed 16 contrasts the zero reference failed (1.58 expected without response). In a preregistered audit, Claude Sonnet 5.5 passed three intention targets, all zero-reference passes, and the registered belief-gradient control; norm beliefs changed 0.065 SD against humans' 0.351 (zero-reference check added after unblinding; norm beliefs emphasized after inspection). Registered tests detected no overestimation; average-effect intervals excluded overestimation above 0.08 SD. A group

translated_title: 匹配人类干预效应能确立什么？LLM模拟的基准检验
translated_abstract: LLM模拟通过与人效应的等效性来验证，然而只要人类90%区间位于容差范围内，零参考点就会自动通过——正如人类基准在模拟之前所显示的那样。当零参考点失败时，计划的精度赋予独立模拟一个容差上限，在此范围内通过构成对响应的5%显著性检验。在一项包含70个实验的探索性再分析中，GPT-4的±0.20 SD通过中有72%属于零参考通过；GPT-4通过了16个零参考未通过的对比（在无响应情况下预期仅为1.58个）。在一项预注册审计中，Claude Sonnet 5.5通过了三个意图目标，全部为零参考通过，同时还通过了注册的信念梯度控制；规范信念仅变化0.065 SD，而人类为0.351 SD（零参考检验在揭盲后添加；规范信念在检查后予以强调）。注册检验未检测到高估；平均效应区间排除了超过0.08 SD的高估。
tldr: 该论文质疑LLM模拟匹配人类干预效应所能确立的有效性，发现大量“通过”实为无信息量的零参考通过，并提出零参考基准与计划精度检验来严格评估LLM模拟的真实响应能力。
en_tdlr: The paper questions what matching a human intervention effect establishes for LLM simulations, showing that many "passes" are trivial zero-reference passes, and introduces benchmark checks to rigorously assess whether LLM simulations genuinely reproduce human responses.
